$description: Octant design tokens in the Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10. Generated by `bun run tokens:export` from apps/web/src/styles/octant.css, apps/web/src/styles/octant-bridge.css, apps/web/src/styles.css, apps/web/src/styles/surface.css, packages/theme/src/tokens.ts. $value is the dark default; the light value, in the same form, is in $extensions["com.octant"].light. A token's key is its CSS custom property name without the leading dashes. Values the format cannot express are not tokens; they are listed under the root $extensions["com.octant"].cssOnly with their CSS value.
